confusable_with.why: sec09-F24 says on a blowout to clamp the wheel straight, lift off the gas and shun the brake, while sec09-F26 says a dead engine calls for steady braking to the roadside; learners brake hard on a blowout

nodes.label: Breakdown parking: fully off right, never past a crest or bend

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach the three escape tools, then anti-lock versus plain emergency braking, then swerving and when speed is the escape
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on braking technique, swerving and accelerating
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on anti-lock stomp-and-hold, swerve steps and escape by speed

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach what causes skids, then the recovery steps with and without anti-lock, then sideways skids and dropping off the pavement edge
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on skid causes, recovery and pavement edges
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on skid recovery, steering into the slide and pavement drop-offs

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach stopping and moving non-injury wrecks, then what to log and parked-car notes, then reporting rules, then aiding the injured
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on scene duties, logging, reporting and aid
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on shoulder moves, report deadlines and aiding victims

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach brake failure, then blowouts, then engine death and runaway accelerators, then safe breakdown parking and flares
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on each failure and its response
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on brake failure order, blowout handling, runaway accelerators and flares

learning_path_rule.rule: topological prerequisite order; module order and handbook order break ties; dynamic nodes never on the path

pair of facts learners commonly swap

sequencing.rule: topological prerequisite order, then module order and handbook order; dynamic excluded
